record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie input and output item embeddings. Initialize the new output table as a copy of the input table, then train both jointly within each category's single NextItNet model. Separate representations may resolve tension between encoding observed items and representing prediction targets. Preserve embedding width, dot-product scoring, features, causal blocks, readout, loss and optimizer. Update checkpoint loading and predictor metadata for the additional table.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie input and output item embeddings across all four category models, initializing the output table as an exact copy without consuming additional initialization randomness. Both tables train jointly within each single NextItNet model. This tests whether separate encoding and target representations help the current configuration, despite regressions in earlier configurations. Preserve width, causal backbone, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer.
